illustration_part_blue_heeler_0001.provisional: A single lump. No legs, ears, muzzle or tail -- nothing that says dog.

illustration_part_esky_0001.provisional: Reads as a car battery. Tabs on the lid instead of handles on the sides, and no overhanging lid lip.

illustration_part_hills_hoist_0001.provisional: Three bars on a pole reads as a telegraph pole. Wants the four-arm frame seen at an angle with lines strung between the arms.

illustration_part_kangaroo_0001.provisional: An upright lump with a stray rectangle. No tail, no hind leg, no ears.

illustration_part_kookaburra_0001.provisional: Two overlapping ovals and a loose parallelogram. The counter is wound the same way as the outline, so it fills solid instead of cutting.

illustration_part_magpie_0001.provisional: A lump. No beak, no tail, and no white panels -- the pied pattern is what names a magpie.

illustration_part_meat_pie_0001.provisional: A thick ring. Reads as a donut or a tyre.

illustration_part_snag_on_bread_0001.provisional: A rounded rectangle with a slot. Nothing in it reads as bread or as a sausage.

illustration_part_southern_cross_0001.provisional: Right idea, wrong constellation. The largest star is at the top when Acrux at the bottom is the brightest, and the small fifth star sits below the kite instead of inside it.

illustration_part_ute_0001.provisional: Reads as a hatchback. No vertical drop behind the cab to a flat tray, and the wheel circles merge into the arches so there are no wheels.

illustration_part_wombat_0001.provisional: A lump. The counter is wound the same way as the outline, so whatever it was meant to cut fills solid.

illustration_part_work_boot_0001.provisional: Reads as a handbag. No sole, no heel, no ankle collar, and the knockout at the top reads as a hole in a bag.
